text: The Bank of Russia is the Central Bank of the Russian Federation: under Article 75 of the Constitution of the Russian Federation, money emission is carried out exclusively by the Central Bank of the Russian Federation.
short: Bank of Russia is the Russian Federation's central bank (Constitution, Art. 75)

source.name: Constitution of the Russian Federation (constitution.ru), Chapter 3, Article 75
source.note: Official web version of the Russian Constitution, as amended with the changes approved in the nationwide vote of 1 July 2020. English: 'Money emission is carried out exclusively by the Central Bank of the Russian Federation.' Article 75 also makes protecting the rouble's stability the main function of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation.
source.quote: Денежная эмиссия осуществляется исключительно Центральным банком Российской Федерации.

additionalSources.name: Bank of Russia (cbr.ru): О Банке России (About the Bank of Russia) — archived copy, snapshot 2025-01-14
additionalSources.note: Archived copy of the central bank's official page (Russian). English: 'The status, goals, functions and powers of the Bank of Russia are determined by the federal law of 10.07.2002 No. 86-FZ "On the Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)"'. The live page (last updated 16.12.2025) carries the same statement but answers the checker's scripts with 403, so the archived copy is cited.
additionalSources.quote: Статус, цели, функции и полномочия Банка России определяются Федеральным законом от 10.07.2002 № 86-ФЗ «О Центральном банке Российской Федерации (Банке России)»
